|errata_history=The published slip contains only the statistics and game-text panel, omitting the header, lore and artwork. The title, destiny and lore listed here are retained from the preceding full-card image shown in the comparison; they are not reproduced on this slip. This is the third documented image (Errata 2); the source prints no errata mark. The image-version ordinal and absent printed mark are recorded in [[Players Committee transcription errors]].<ref>[[:File:Virtual-Set-7-September-2023.pdf|Official Set7 sheet, September 2023 edition]], page 3.</ref>
* '''Original''' ([[Help Me Obi-Wan Kenobi (V)]]): PC card image uploaded by 8 July 2018<ref name="img-helpmeobiwankenobi022435b">Players Committee card image <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual7-Light/large/helpmeobiwankenobi.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable repository, version of [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/022435b7929e4de26dafbcb1de2ec1d6d04d2153 commit 022435b] (by 8 July 2018); the PC serves the same file at https://res.starwarsccg.org/cards/Virtual7-Light/large/helpmeobiwankenobi.gif (today's copy is the latest version only). The commit date is the upload date; the PC's errata announcement may differ by days.</ref> (earliest copy found: the first commit of the repository; the card was printed earlier and no earlier image of it was found). Document: no errata mark; bottom margin “Help Me Obi-Wan Kenobi”. Text: “During battle, target an opponent's character of ability &lt; 2 present with your Jedi; target is excluded from battle. OR Cancel a 'react'. OR If Obi-Wan is at a battleground site, and your Rebel or Republic character (or Leia) is in battle at another location, add one battle destiny.”
* '''PC-E1''' ([[Help Me Obi-Wan Kenobi (V) (Errata)]]): PC card image uploaded 4 November 2022<ref name="img-helpmeobiwankenobia57375e">Players Committee card image <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual7-Light/large/helpmeobiwankenobi.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable repository, version of [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/a57375eaf483d0e05592c08185b77505a415f0e5 commit a57375e] (4 November 2022); the PC serves the same file at https://res.starwarsccg.org/cards/Virtual7-Light/large/helpmeobiwankenobi.gif (today's copy is the latest version only). The commit date is the upload date; the PC's errata announcement may differ by days.</ref>. '''What changed:''' the PC re-made the image at higher resolution (350×490 → 745×1039 pixels); the words of the game text are the same as the previous image. A visible change on the card, so it is its own version (Bill, 12 Nov 2026). Document: no errata mark; bottom margin “Help Me Obi-Wan Kenobi”. It is the current full-face image (the same file as the wiki's existing image). Text: “During battle, target an opponent's character of ability &lt; 2 present with your Jedi; target is excluded from battle. OR Cancel a 'react'. OR If Obi-Wan is at a battleground site, and your Rebel or Republic character (or Leia) is in battle at another location, add one battle destiny.”
